Exemple illustratif : un particulier sou: An illustrative example: a private individual wants to change the circulation of a garden while retaining a terrace. He joins two photos and explains the passages he uses. The landscaper prepares a visit focusing on these uses, then checks the constraints on the site before proposing an arrangement.
Invitez le prospect à préciser les activ: Invite the prospect to specify the desired activities and elements that it wants to keep. Separate a development project from a recurrent maintenance request. The reference photos express a preference, without constituting an identical promise of reproduction. The page explains that the study of the land and the final choices then take place with the professional; it avoids deducing the conditions of a land from its commune.
Le dossier reçu rassemble les usages, le: The file received includes the uses, items to be retained and points still unknown. He can prepare a list of questions for the visit. Test a planless case, a multi-phase project and a change in need after sending. Applications should not be rejected for a missing photo if optional, or presented as an already completed study.
Le site ne fournit pas un diagnostic du: The site does not provide a soil diagnosis, plant selection or remote work feasibility. No climate, maintenance or local result is automatically derived from the geographical data. The estimate specifies the study and agreed deliverables.
Préparer un compte rendu d’intervention: Prepare an intervention report to be validated →

Transformer le brief en ordre du jour: Turning the brief into an agenda
Un plan ou une photo peut aider à prépar: A plan or photo can help prepare the visit if the visitor indicates what the document represents and its approximate date. Ask for an indicative area, address and access to be examined, with the possibility of replying later. Do not require a document without explaining its use. Project references posted on the site should specify the actual mission, rather than suggest an unproven local experience.
Une demande d’aménagement extérieur devi: A request for exterior layout becomes more useful when the visitor explains what he wants to do in space. A gallery may give ideas, but it does not say what access, constraints and existing elements should be preserved. The site can arrange this information before the first appointment.
Usages et éléments à conserver: Uses and items to be retained
